findings.detail: image_hook.py:45-53 requires exact original SHA, unique anchors and reversibility after removing only injected preamble/hook. Hook immediately precedes original five-condition demand; every original byte and guard retained. No shipping sampler/validator modification.

Original guard still executes; PASS requires all predicates true, REJECTED requires matching retained failure. No class/protection interpretation.

Main, FileManager getter and NSURL getter each call observe; observation/count reset and original exceptions caught per call. Main must PASS; an FM rejection does not suppress URL capture. Only closed exception labels retained, never descriptions. This observes method identity, not getter invocation/downstream behavior.

Original parser bounds commands4096/1MiB; full platform IDs bounded4096. JSON output capped256KiB. Only image basename; no absolute pointer/header/slide/path serialized. Relative offset emitted only when nonnegative and<2^40; otherwise null, never substituted zero.

Pure Objective-C GNU11/ARC constructs plausible with APP04 host flags. Compile guards require arm64 macOS and exclude Simulator/Catalyst; runtime nonroot uid/euid equality and macOS15. Native entry only attributes addresses; no explicit filesystem protection query/write, simulator, app, Gradle or KMP execution. transform(bytes)->bytes; validate(dict,five-string binding)->summary agrees with lifecycle driver handshake.
